claims: Ludwig Göransson won Best Original Score for Sinners at the 2026 Academy Awards.
Ludwig Göransson's win for Sinners at the 2026 Academy Awards marked his third Oscar win.
Ludwig Göransson beat out nominees including Alexandre Desplat (Frankenstein), Jerskin Fendrix (Bugonia), Jonny Greenwood (One Battle After Another), and Max Richter (Hamnet).
